title: Tier-D MNT loan 14: 14 paused days inside an active pause are not delinquent (61 overdue -> 44 delinquent)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the delinquent block of Tier-D MNT loan 14 at business date 2023-12-01. request.delinquency carries the observed overdue-since civil date 2023-10-01 (delinquent.pastDueDate [2023,10,1]), the business date, the observed graceOnArrearsAgeing 3, and the paused-day count 14 derived from the active pause period [2023-11-17, 2023-12-01] the read-back carries. expect.overdue_days 61 and expect.delinquent_days 44 are TRANSCRIPTIONS of delinquent.pastDueDays 61 and delinquent.delinquentDays 44. THE PROPERTY GRADED: days inside a delinquency pause do not count as delinquent. OverdueDays(2023-10-01, 2023-12-01) = 31 (October) + 30 (November) = 61; DelinquentDays(61, 14, 3) = 61 - 14 - 3 = 44. The pause [2023-11-17, 2023-12-01] overlaps [2023-10-01, 2023-12-01] for exactly 14 days, and Min(2023-12-01, business 2023-12-01) - Max(2023-11-17, overdue 2023-10-01) = 14; grace 3 is corroborated by delinquent.delinquentDate [2023,10,4] = pastDueDate + 3. The observed delinquentDays 44 DOES reproduce under the port's DelinquentDays from the observed inputs, so no port discrepancy is recorded here. NOT GRADED: the negative clamp in OverdueDays (no overdue date is after the business date), and any balance-named cell (none appears in this vector). This is tenant `tierd`, NOT tenant `gerege`.
